questions.q: What is JSON Schema used for?
options: Compressing JSON files to save bandwidth
Describing what a piece of JSON is allowed to look like — required fields, types, and valid values
Converting JSON into XML
Encrypting JSON request bodies
questions.explain: JSON Schema is a specification for describing the shape and constraints a piece of JSON must satisfy — itself written in JSON.

questions.q: In a JSON Schema, what does the "required" keyword do?
options: Lists which keys from "properties" must be present in the instance
Specifies the maximum number of properties allowed
Automatically fills in missing values
Has no effect; it's purely documentation
questions.explain: "required" is an array of key names that must be present; any key not listed there is optional.

questions.q: Given the schema's role field defined as {"enum": ["admin", "member"]}, why would {"name": "Ada", "role": "owner"} be invalid?
options: Because "name" is spelled wrong
Because "owner" isn't one of the values listed in the enum
Because JSON doesn't allow the word "owner"
It's actually valid
questions.explain: The enum keyword restricts a value to an exact fixed list; "owner" isn't in ["admin", "member"], so it fails validation.

questions.q: In the example schema, "age" has a type but is not listed in "required". What does that mean for an instance missing "age"?
options: The instance automatically fails validation
The instance is still valid — "age" is optional since it isn't in "required"
JSON Schema doesn't support optional fields
"age" being absent makes the whole schema invalid, not the instance
questions.explain: Only keys listed in "required" must be present; omitting an optional field like "age" doesn't fail validation.

questions.q: Per this lesson, where does JSON Schema show up again later in this course?
options: It never appears again after this lesson
Only in CSS styling for API documentation sites
In Chapter 3, where AI provider structured output and tool-calling definitions are built from JSON Schema
Only as a way to format error messages
questions.explain: Chapter 3 shows that AI providers' structured output and tool/function-calling schemas are built using this exact type/properties/required vocabulary.
